title: Extract all part types from Grok Bot transcript blobs
description: Decode conversation blobs and map entries to normalized parts with provenance. Done when: fixture extraction yields the expected parts with skip counting.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Extraction maps entry logs into chapter-1 Messages ordered by the explicit seq (shuffled file order normalized): message entries -> Text parts with role mapping and persona author preserved on message.author; voice-call entries stay opaque as Part::Extra verbatim; unknown types and malformed lines counted. A capped log (capped:true, 200 entries, server-side continuation) flags the session as PartialHistory{reason: LocalCap}. Cloud-agent records surface as discovery session stubs carrying status and PR metadata. Full gate green.

right_now_summary: The team is extracting and normalizing parts from Grok Bot transcript blobs.
